result.summary: Found 1 visual layout issue where a restaurant title is prematurely clipped mid-character despite available horizontal space.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' has its final letter 'n' cut off mid-character ('Tokumaru Rameı'), even though there is plenty of empty space between the title and the rating on the right.
issues.suggestion: Expand the width constraint or flex-grow setting of the restaurant title container so it can utilize the available space before the rating badge, and use `text-overflow: ellipsis` if truncation is genuinely needed for longer names.
